channel.title: Jonjoe1001 - Dev Log
channel.description: Progress reports, problems I got stuck on, and things I figured out while building games and tools.

item.title: Limitless Lab is open: 20 free things to poke
item.description: Games, science sims and maker tools that run right in your browser. Free, private and phone-first, so anyone can explore big ideas by playing with them.

item.title: The Starlight Update is HERE!
item.description: Every screen in Timeless got rebuilt from the ground up (yes, EVERY one) plus new sounds, button glyphs, a real tutorial and a pile of fixes. Come see what we've been cooking!

item.title: How do you teach something to walk without telling it how?
item.description: The theory behind Emergent Evolver: brains that grow their own neurons, why evolution cheats every chance it gets, and the fixes that finally got my creatures walking.

item.title: Building this site from scratch
item.description: Why I hand-wrote this whole site instead of grabbing a template, and the plan for eventually hosting it on the NAS in my closet.
